newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar ends off but up from day's lows.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar ends off but up from day's lows.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures closed weaker but above lows hit early when the funds failed to follow through and mixed selling pressured prices, floor sources said.

By midmorning, the locals were forced to cover short positions once the March contract failed to take out 78.00. Steady trade buying and light speculative buying carried prices to only barely below unchanged, by the close.
"The locals got short early and they were looking for a breakdown. When the market held at 78.00 they were forced to buy back to 86.00 (March delivery)," a floor source said.
Resistance remained at 11.00 and then 11.05 cents a lb for March sugar.
The contract settled 0.06 cent lower at 10.94 cents, traded 10.98 to 10.78. The back months ended unchanged to 0.06 weaker.
Support remained at the recent low of 10.63 cents made Dec 19, basis the March contract.
